notes: Killed at milestone 2 per kill rule (both milestones <= 0.04 floor, S_held flat). S_held moved only -0.109 -> -0.088 over 600 steps (~0.02, plateaued after step ~350) while bench DROPPED from 0.04 to 0.0 at step250 and step500, with degenerate behavior (12-17/25 RepeatedAction exits, zero Submitted, wall time 60-90s vs 296s for base). Key mechanistic finding from component diagnostic (128 thoughts, 32 turns, all with distractors): the specificity term never fires - distractor lift max(0, lift(y_distractor)) was 0.0 on 100% of sampled thoughts, so the contrastive score degenerates to the plain reason score in practice. Raw hint lift was negative for 97% of base-miner thoughts (median -0.064), so RAFT kept only 0-11/384 thoughts per round (~2%); training was therefore dominated by the 1:1 backbone CE distillation on teacher rollouts, which itself appears to induce the RepeatedAction degeneracy.
